2026-08-23 critical re-audit: user rejected the prior Shot019 chain because the three women read like a static queue and Annette's fog action read as a feature demonstration. v2 separates the jobs in depth: Mercedes guides the civilians, Annette makes one restrained physical opening in the fog, and Ingrid covers the flank; END leaves a real empty road for Catherine.

2026-08-23 critical re-audit: user correctly rejected Shot022 v2 because Dimitri was visually too Ashe-like and the Byleth foreground blocking could read as Byleth facing three people. v2 is blocked. v3 rebuilds the identity and blocking together: Ashe is the only silver-haired archer and owns the only bow; Dimitri is separated by blond hair, bright blue cape, high collar, and sword; the main eyeline is Ashe to Lonato; Byleth remains small in the far right rear.

2026-08-23 critical re-audit: user again rejected Shot018 as visually stiff. v4 had the right idea but still read too much like a posed defensive demonstration. v5 is regenerated as one integrated action chain: START catches Felix in a real lateral step across Ashe, KEY carries his weight through one left-edge blade contact, and END recovers into a left-facing guard plus a low exit cue toward the right-rear path.

2026-08-23 critical re-audit: user again rejected Shot019 as visually stiff. v2 separated the jobs but still read like a three-person staging diagram. v3 is regenerated with actual motion lines and depth: Mercedes walks the civilians uphill, Annette crosses through a narrow natural fog gap, and Ingrid backs along the wall while covering the flank; END clears the central road for Catherine.

2026-08-23 critical re-audit: user feedback requires live-action frames that do not read as static game-like portraits. Shot020 v3 had correct female Byleth and Thunderbrand identity, but START and END still read as a posed trio. v4 regenerates the chain as moving entry, one localized Thunderbrand cut, and a layered forward handoff: Catherine enters at left, Byleth and Ashe move through different depths, and END leaves the route open for Shot021.

2026-08-23 critical re-audit: user again rejected Shot018 because the prior web candidate still read as a wide action diagram. v6 rebuilds the visual grammar as three materially different live-action states: START is a hard lateral entry across Ashe, KEY is a tight single-blade bind with Felix's body torque, and END is a grounded recovery that physically sends Ashe toward the open exit.

2026-08-23 critical re-audit: user again rejected Shot019 because the prior three-person support line still read as a staging diagram and exceeded the source beat. v4 returns to the shot-list's two-person action: Mercedes physically guides one indistinct civilian into the fog while Annette crosses the near plane and opens a practical visibility lane; END leaves the center road empty for Catherine.
